releases.title: Real rates in every script + HubSpot notes
items: Every call script now has an OFFER line with our current rate for the program that fits that borrower: fix-and-flip 9.99%, ground-up 10.25%, refinance 10.75%, commercial 11.99%. Florida uses Florida pricing (fix-and-flip 10.25%, refinance and ground-up 10.75%).
The script picks the program for you: flippers get fix-and-flip, builders get ground-up, holders and anyone with a loan coming due get refinance.
Each script ends with an internal PRICING line (points and doc fee for Florida) for you, not to read out loud. All subject to underwriting.
Sharper closes: a takeout ask for loans coming due, a build-budget ask for builders, a payoff ask for holders.
NEW button: App started. Hit it when a borrower sends a deal or application.
NEW button: Copy for HubSpot. Copies a ready-made call note (who, when, result, call-back) to paste into the contact in HubSpot, so the whole team can see who called whom.
Your password, notes, owners and reminders all carry over.

releases.title: Deal history + real call scripts
items: NEW: DEAL HISTORY on every borrower. Open a row to see their total loans and when they started, how many properties they've sold in the last 3 years, how many they own right now, new loans in the last 12 months and 90 days, short-term %, average loan, the city they buy in, and their last deal (address, date, amount, lender).
NEW: They're tagged Flipper, Holder, Flips and holds, Builder or Newer, plus whether they're active right now or have gone quiet.

NEW: FULL CALL SCRIPT replaces the one-line talk track: OPEN (mentions their last deal), WHY I'M CALLING (based on their situation), 3 questions to ASK, the CLOSE (get the next deal and an email for the term sheet), and what to say if they already have a lender.

Detailed numbers show only when we verified it's the same person (same name and state, plus the same company, city or lender). About 3 in 4 people on the CALL QUEUE are verified. The rest show basic data only.
Your password, notes, owners and reminders all carry over.

releases.title: Ty's full name
items: Ty now shows as Ty Thompson in the Owner dropdown, MY DAY, TEAM FOLLOW-UPS and the call log. Anything already assigned to "Ty" moves over automatically.
Your password, notes, owners and reminders all carry over.

releases.title: Red flags: full sweep done
items: RED FLAGS: full sweep done. 345 borrowers on our lists now carry ⚠ RED FLAG — CHECK FIRST, up from 99. records show foreclosure-related negative remarks for each one. Every flag is verified as the same person by name and state, plus the same city or a shared lender. Name-only matches (44) were left unflagged.
Where they are: CALL QUEUE 211, IN PLAY 90, WIN-BACKS 73, WIN-BACK 2.0 19, and they show on each state tab too. Check the full record before you offer new money.
RENAMED: CF1 LOOKUP (NOVA) is now CF1 LOOKUP (HubSpot). Past borrowers' contact info lives in HubSpot, so look them up there.
Your password, notes, owners and reminders all carry over.

releases.title: Call-back reminders, LO ownership, and lender intel
items: NEW: RED FLAGS. 99 borrowers on our priority lists have pre-foreclosure filings on record (checked 10/5). Each was verified as the same person by name, state and lender history. They're tagged ⚠ RED FLAG — CHECK FIRST, with the details in the talk track. Use the Tier filter to see them. More are being checked.
FIXED: The DASHBOARD no longer shows spreadsheet formulas. It opens with your live progress.

NEW: Call-back reminders, like HubSpot tasks. Open a borrower, pick a date and time, add a note, and hit Set reminder. When it's due, a pop-up appears on screen (and a desktop alert if you allow it). Buttons: Done, +1 hour, Cancel.
NEW: Send any reminder to Google Calendar or to your phone/Outlook (.ics file with a 10-minute alarm), so it reaches you even when this page is closed.

NEW: Owner dropdown on every borrower. Assign Anthony, Gabe or Ty, or mark "Another CF1 LO" so nobody double-calls someone a teammate already has. Those rows show a purple "Other LO has it" tag and drop out of MY DAY.

NEW: Follow-ups go to the owner's own list. Set the Owner to Gabe or Ty and set a reminder, and it lands on their MY DAY, not yours. Anthony sees everyone's on TEAM FOLLOW-UPS. To hand them off: Anthony hits Export my progress and sends the file; Gabe or Ty clicks Import from Anthony.
NEW: Filters for Scheduled call-backs, Owned by me, and Belongs to another LO.

NEW: Status on every borrower. Each row shows New, Viewed, 2× tried, Follow-up due, Reached or Closed, plus when it was last touched and by whom. You can always see who has been worked and who hasn't.

NEW: Log a call in one click. Open a row and hit No answer, Voicemail, Reached, Texted, Emailed or Wrong number. It stamps the time and your name, fills Called and Claimed By, and sets a follow-up 2 days out for no-answers (7 days after the 3rd try).
NEW: MY DAY tab. Your follow-ups due today and everyone you've tried but not reached yet, pulled from every tab into one list.
NEW: Status filter on every tab. Show only borrowers you've never touched, ones you tried but haven't reached, follow-ups due, reached, or closed out.
NEW: WIN-BACK 2.0. Capital Fund I borrowers who went quiet or left us in the last 6 months, with who they left for and the line to use against that lender.

NEW: IN PLAY is now 671 borrowers. Each one went dormant or switched away from Roc360, CV3, Lima One, Dominion, Rain City, Park Place, Anchor, Loan Ranger, Rehab Wallet, Windstone, Bell Rock or Pantheon in the last 6 months, and each has a verified phone. Every row says where they went and gives the line to use.
NEW: CF1 LOOKUP (HubSpot). 1,454 former CF1 borrowers who went quiet or left but aren't on the phone list. Their contact info is in HubSpot. Look them up there and work them from this tab.
NEW: Top lenders at the top of every state tab: who funds the most flips there, who's growing, who's shrinking, and where CF1 ranks. All 8 states are on the MARKET SHARE tab.
Rehab Wallet now shows by name (it records loans as PIC Fund I). It's #1 in SC with 12.5% share, down 4 points.
RED FLAG: Luis Mata (top of CALL QUEUE) has a Notice of Foreclosure dated 9/24/2026. His row says to check with CF1 servicing before pitching.
Your password, notes and check-offs all carry over.

releases.title: Competitor refresh + smarter call notes
items: All 30 competitor rate sheets re-verified from the lenders' own sites (as of Oct 5). Six material changes — see the COMPETITOR TERMS tab, 'What changed' column.
RCN Capital now publishes its full rate sheet: rental from 6.00%, construction from 9.84%; DSCR leverage tiers by FICO (80% at 700+, 75% at 680–699, 65% at 660–679). Positioning updated.
Kiavi now lists 44 states + DC — all eight of ours included. Rates unchanged since the Figure acquisition closed Sept 1.
Genesis Capital now says 'exclusively experienced investors' — a clean handoff line for newer borrowers who get turned away.
Merchants Mortgage now claims nationwide fix-and-flip lending (was Colorado-centric). Verify license before quoting them as absent in a state.
Constructive Capital is now a captive originator of Adamas Trust (formerly NYMT) — $422M Q1 originations; treat them as well-funded, not a small shop.
Maturity countdowns ('Days') re-based to today, so the DUE <90 DAYS tier reflects this week.
Call notes upgraded: Reached? and Outcome are dropdowns, Called and Follow-Up are date pickers, and the Called date + Claimed By fill in automatically the first time you mark a lead reached or done.
This 'What's new' panel. It shows once per update; reopen it any time from the button in the top bar.
Your password and your saved progress carry over — nothing to redo.

releases.title: Launch
items: First release: 43,264 borrowers across CO, AZ, TX, GA, NC, SC, TN, FL; scored and tiered; talk track on every row; 12 competitor tabs; win-backs; current CF1 clients.
Setup codes per person, your own password after that.
Progress saves in your browser — use 'Export my progress' on Fridays.
